description: The dataset records aerosol size‑distribution measurements taken at the Neumayer Station (latitude ‑70.65°, longitude ‑8.25°, elevation 42 m). Each record is indexed by an integer and corresponds to a fixed instrument height of 7 m and a one‑hour sampling interval (Time min = 60). The timestamp fields provide start and end times with second‑ and minute‑resolution. Columns dN/dlogDp(...) report particle concentrations for 45 size bins ranging from 92.87 nm to 4845.51 nm, with values spanning from 0 up to several hundred particles cm⁻³. Geographic coordinates and a constant event label identify the scientific expedition. These data support atmospheric‑science studies such as aerosol climatology, cloud‑formation research, and model validation.
